# Snowcraft Reforged

> A free, browser-based remake of the classic 1999 SnowCraft snowball-fight game, built with Phaser 4. Click and hold to charge a throw, release to throw a snowball along a fixed diagonal, and defeat the opposing green team across ten progressively harder levels.

Snowcraft Reforged is an open, HTML5 game that runs entirely in the browser — no install, no account, no ads. It preserves the original 1999 sprite art, sound, rules and timing, and adds three difficulty settings and a display that scales to any screen.

## Key facts

- **Name**: Snowcraft Reforged
- **Genre**: Action / Arcade / Casual snowball-fight game
- **Platform**: Web browser (HTML5 canvas, desktop)
- **Engine**: Phaser 4.2
- **Price**: Free (no ads, no signup, no in-app purchases)
- **Author**: Richard Crane (ChiefInnovator), MILL5
- **Source**: https://github.com/ChiefInnovator/snowcraftai
- **Play online**: https://chiefinnovator.github.io/snowcraftai/
- **Levels**: 10 progressive levels (3, 5, 7, 9, then 12 enemies)
- **Difficulty settings**: Easy, Normal, Hard
- **Native resolution**: 592x320 stage, shown at 600x320 and scalable up to 1800x960
- **Inspired by**: SnowCraft (1999)

## How to play

1. Point at a red team player, then click and hold to begin charging throw power. You can drag them while you hold.
2. A power meter fills in eight steps over about two-thirds of a second — longer holds throw farther.
3. Release the mouse button to throw. Snowballs always fly up and to the left, so line up by moving.
4. Defeat every green team player to clear the level and advance.
5. Beat all ten levels to win. The green team throws back, so keep moving.

## Gameplay mechanics

- **Throws**: fixed 2:1 diagonal (red up-left, green down-right); range grows with power 0–8, from about 60 to 360 px.
- **Hits**: snowballs can only hit while in flight, not as they drop to the ground.
- **Red team**: 2 hits to knock out; the first dazes a kid for about 4.5 s (can't be picked up, can still be hit).
- **Green team**: 3 hits on Normal (2 on Easy, 4 on Hard); the hit before the last knocks them down and makes them briefly immune.
- **Enemy AI**: never aims — it wanders, sidesteps and throws at random power; each team can have at most 10 snowballs in the air.
- **Levels**: 3, 5, 7, 9, then 12 green kids for levels 5–10. Clearing level 10 wins.
- **Score**: +1 per green kid on each cleared level; on a loss, (score + kills this level) × level; a full clear multiplies by 10, up to 1000.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Snowcraft Reforged?** A free browser remake of the 1999 SnowCraft snowball-fight game, built with Phaser 4.

**Is it free?** Yes — completely free, no account, no ads, no purchases.

**Do I need to install anything?** No. It runs in any modern desktop browser.

**How many levels are there?** Ten, each harder than the last.

**What browsers work?** Any modern browser with HTML5 canvas — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
